An off-lock frame was answered the moment it arrived, so a pong sent
after a list_sessions overtook the session_list or error frame behind
it on the wire, and any client draining its connection on its own
heartbeat read the answer as missing. The acceptance suites drain
exactly that way. createMessageHandler now chains a socket's off-lock
answers through a per-socket promise: arrival order without ever
joining the turn queue, and one failed answer never takes it down.

The validators table becomes a Map keyed by the snake_case wire names,
which camelcase refused as record identifiers and prettier would have
unst-quoted back.

Refs #144
